scene_desc: Chandler and Joey's, Monica and Chandler are making out on one of the chairs.
They wait for Joey to go into his room and close the door and then start making out again.
Pause.
Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, and Monica are there as Phoebe enters carrying a large box.
Phoebe puts her leg up on the chair and removes this huge knife from her boot to open the box with. The guys are shocked at the knife's existence.
Ross suddenly gets up and heads for the bathroom.
The Storage Room in the basement of Monica and Rachel's building, Monica and Rachel are looking for something.
The single light flickers and goes out. Leaving the room in total darkness.
They both start screaming at the top of their lungs.
Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe are there.
Ross exits.
Monica and Rachel enter breathless.
Their Building, Monica and Rachel are going to apologize to Danny. Rachel knocks on his door, which he opens and he has this really bushy beard and long hair. Picture Paul Bunyan.
He closes the door. Rachel's not happy with that and knocks again. He opens the door.
He closes the door again. Rachel knocks harder this time and he answers it.
He closes the door before Rachel can say anything.
Monica and Rachel's, Monica is making a drink as Phoebe enters with the fur coat.
Rachel enters from the bathroom and sees the coat.

Ross's Apartment, the gang is helping Ross move out by carrying boxes. Chandler has picked a particularly large and apparently heavy box, because he takes a running start at it and still can't budge it.
He picks up a smaller box and carries it to the moving van as Joey returns.
